endpoints.screen: Appointment Detail (business-owner app)
endpoints.description: status: in_progress (check in / start), completed, no_show (only after the start time), cancelled (cancelReason 'business' unless a reason is sent; makes the whole paid deposit refundable). Returns the full Booking. Completing is allowed here until charge-booking exists. no_show sets noShowFee on the Booking (BK-64): { percent, fee, kept, uncollected } — the business's noShow.feePercent of the total, kept out of any paid deposit (capped at it); leftover deposit becomes a refund owed, the rest of the fee is uncollected. endpoints.screen: Appointment Detail → Charge customer (owner / front desk)
endpoints.description: The final charge at checkout (PaymentKind.CHARGE on the server), for an in_progress booking. The amount is the balance: totalAmount minus any deposit already paid. Same shape as start-booking-payment so both use one polling pattern. method 'cash': records it immediately and returns 200 with the Booking (status completed, paymentStatus paid, paymentMethod cash). method 'mpesa': sends an STK push to phone (any Kenyan format; defaults to the booking's customerPhone) routed to the business's own till/paybill/bank, and returns 202 at once. The app then polls GET /bookings/{bookingId} every 3s for up to ~2 min: success = status completed + paymentStatus paid, with paymentReference (M-Pesa receipt) and paymentMethod mpesa set; failure = chargePayment.status failed | timeout with a failureReason (same values as depositPayment). The customer can be re-prompted after a failure. No balance due (deposit covered everything): mpesa behaves like cash and completes immediately. If an M-Pesa charge lands after the booking was already paid another way (e.g. cash while the prompt was open), it's recorded as a refund owed (refund.status due). App: AppointmentDetailScreen's Charge customer sheet (src/api/booking.ts#chargeBookingPayment polls until paid or failed). Also accepts a completed booking that isn't paid yet (e.g. staff marked it done): the app offers Charge customer on in_progress, or completed with paymentStatus !== 'paid'. Cancelled, no-show and pending bookings get 409 not_in_progress. Tip (2026-10-20): optional `tip` (KES, 0-100000) for the booking's staff member, charged together with the balance in one payment (one M-Pesa prompt for balance + tip). Once the payment succeeds it's credited to their wallet as a `tip` (linked to the booking), the booking's `tip` is set, and they're notified. It's not revenue: earnings' totalRevenue excludes it; money.tips and day-summary collected.tips show it. 400 tip_needs_staff if nobody is assigned.

bookingChanges.description: Booking gains balanceDue (what charge-booking would take now) and chargePayment (null until an M-Pesa charge is started).

endpoints.screen: Earnings (business-owner app)
endpoints.description: Computed on the server from paid bookings, following the rules src/utils/earnings.ts used to apply (buckets: 3-hour for one day, daily up to 16 days, weekly up to 70, monthly beyond). from/to are business-local days, inclusive, ≤366 days apart. services lists every current service (0 rows included) plus deleted ones that earned money in the range (serviceId null). transactions: one row per service performed, newest first; transactionsLimit returns the newest N and transactionsTotal the count. Extras: currency, granularity, paidBookings, commission (the scoped person's, or everyone's), staff[] (per-person breakdown on the whole-business view), money (deposits, cancellation fees, refunds), previous (the same-length period before, with revenueChangePercent). App: hooks/useEarningsSummary on Earnings, Member Detail (staffId, only once they have one) and the staff app's Earnings; presets send transactionsLimit=10. money.noShowFees = fees kept from no-shows' deposits in the range (not in totalRevenue). Dates (2026-10-20): paid bookings count on the day they were paid (cash basis, like the wallet and day summary), so a visit done early or charged late lands on the day the money came in; others on the day they were booked for. money.tips: tips paid with checkout charges (in collected, not in totalRevenue).
